verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms an llms.txt file is served at docs.capacities.io/llms.txt, describing the Capacities documentation. The docs are also published as raw Markdown URLs, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is available at api.capacities.io/openapi.json, so an agent can consume the docs directly. The openapi 404s on the docs domain do not contradict this, because the spec lives on the api domain. Missing for 10: a first-party page explaining how agents should use llms.txt, and evidence of an llms-full.txt or full llms.txt contents (the probe output is truncated).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Capacities publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI document at api.capacities.io/openapi.json
